biography.value: Ice Titans apply Frozen on any hit at - Margin 1: — there is no preliminary Chilled or Numbed step. Absolute Zero Aura compounds existing cold conditions automatically, meaning Frozen enemies adjacent to the Ice Titan take additional damage from the aura every round on top of whatever the Titan is actively doing to them. Glacial Barrage applies Frozen to multiple targets simultaneously at range. A summoner who has a Cooperative Ice Titan targeting a formation will find that formation effectively unable to take offensive action within two rounds — too cold, too slow, too Restrained to threaten anyone who isn't also standing in the aura.

system.attacksNotes:
World Freeze [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str) + 4 cold damage (Half DR); target Frozen + Prone; no save.
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage; Frozen + Prone + Grappled + Restrained; ongoing 16 cold damage per round; no save; Fortitude save (Hard task, 2 successes) each round to break free.
  • Margin 3: 21 damage + 10 cold damage + immediately Engulfed in ice; Blinded + Restrained + ongoing 24 cold damage; Might/Acrobatics [Hard] check as full [Combat] action to escape, or ally must melt or break free (2 Interact actions with fire or 3 without).

Glacial Barrage [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 120 ft, up to 3 targets within 30 feet of each other.

  • Margin 1:: 18 cold damage (15 + 3 Dex) + Frosted.
  • Margin 2: 18 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + movement halved.
  • Margin 3: 18 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + Prone; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Absolute Zero Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 20 feet take 9 cold damage (Half DR). Frosted creatures in this range become Frozen. Frozen creatures in this range take an additional 8 cold damage (Half DR) from the intensifying cold. Cold Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 3 designated allies gain immunity to non-magical cold damage within 60 feet. Powerful Build: Ice Titan counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Permafrost: Ground within 40 feet of the Glacier Giant where it has stood for at least 1 round becomes frozen. Frozen ground is Difficult Terrain and creatures moving across it make Acrobatics [Easy] checks or fall Prone. Ice Stride: Moves across ice and snow at full speed. Creates a thin frost trail wherever it walks; surfaces within 5 feet of its path become Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Ice Titan fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
